title: Coordinate-Free Automatic Differentiation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12776v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic differentiation (AD) is a cornerstone of modern machine learning. Since all AD frameworks implicitly fix a basis of Euclidean space to define gradients and Jacobians, they natively process mathematical objects that are arrays of a fixed set of coordinates. This makes it awkward to express objects such as rotations, volume forms, and curvatures that arise, for example, in applications of AI to science. Bespoke workarounds lack reusability. We show that (i) a single, basis-independent derivative operator can represent many geometric differential operations, and (ii) this operator can be expressed entirely in terms of existing AD primitives. This reusable transformation can be composed with JAX batching, compilation, and hardware acceleration. Geometry enters as algebraic data. translated_abstract: 自动微分（AD）是现代机器学习的基石。由于所有自动微分框架都隐式地固定了欧几里得空间的一组基来定义梯度和雅可比矩阵，它们天然处理的是由一组固定坐标构成的数组型数学对象。这使得表达旋转、体积形式和曲率等对象变得十分笨拙，而这类对象恰恰出现在诸如人工智能应用于科学的场景中。为此定制的变通方法缺乏可复用性。我们证明：(i) 单一的、与基无关的导数算子可以表示多种几何微分运算；(ii) 该算子可以完全用现有的自动微分原语来表达。这种可复用的变换能够与 JAX 的批处理、编译以及硬件加速相组合。几何以代数数据的形式进入系统。我们通过实验演示了该算子在不同流形算子之间的复用、在时空反问题处理流水线中的组合运用，以及……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个与坐标（基）无关的统一导数算子，可完全由现有自动微分原语实现，从而以可复用、可组合的方式表达旋转、体积形式、曲率等几何微分运算，并与 JAX 的批处理、编译和硬件加速兼容。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a single coordinate-free (basis-independent) derivative operator, expressible entirely in terms of existing AD primitives, enabling reusable and composable computation of geometric differential operations such as rotations, volume forms, and curvatures, compatible with JAX batching, compilation, and hardware acceleration.
